whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Harvest Bakery,

I noticed your bakery has stellar 4.9★ reviews from 220+ customers behind Paras Hospital on Bailey Road, but lacked a dedicated online ordering and menu showcase page.

Maine aapki bakery ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp cake booking, fresh daily menu, aur location directions integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/harvest

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Team Harvest Bakery, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke business ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp cake ordering and your exact location behind Paras Hospital on Bailey Road. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact products aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
